issue: Initial O3b-F F3 cross-interface matcher paired Q_a with K_a because fit_metric consumed data[ka]; it did not pair Q_a with K_b.
impact: Only the initial O3b-F Q-K pair-matcher table was invalid. O3b-D/E and O3b-F F0 K-K factorized baseline were unaffected.
resolution: Patched a1_v24_o3b_f.py to use an explicit qk_b field, and ran a formal exact K-K addendum on the original O3b-D/E protocol.
